posts.text:
Meta disputes columnist's claim that its Muse agent read private Mac messages

Inc. columnist Jason Aten says Muse quoted his messages with Full Disk Access switched off, and Meta says reading Messages needs three separate permissions.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-muse-messages-dispute/

Anthropic lets developers rewrite Claude Code with TypeScript mods

Anthropic says a mod, a short TypeScript function shipped inside a plugin, can rewrite prompts, block tool calls or draw new interface in Claude Code.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-claude-code-mods/

ChatGPT adds virtual try-on, built on its Images 2.5 model

OpenAI is rolling out a Try On button in ChatGPT shopping results that puts clothes on a user's own selfie or full-body photo, TechCrunch reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-chatgpt-virtual-try-on/

Tavus says its Griffin video model passed for human 48% of the time

Tavus says 48% of study participants took its Griffin model for a real person after a one-minute video call, against 2% for earlier AI systems.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-tavus-griffin/

Perplexity and AWS both open-source small decision models in one day

Perplexity released its OneJev decision models under Apache 2.0, and Amazon's Strands Labs shipped a 2-billion-parameter rival, both claiming speed and low price.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-decision-models-perplexity-aws/

Physicist releases BootLoops, an open toolkit for exact LLM calculations

Harvard's Matthew Schwartz says BootLoops, a free harness for any language model, helped finish 30 Feynman integrals, 15 of them calculations not previously completed.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-bootloops-schwartz/

Microsoft adds streaming transcription and two voice models to its MAI line

Microsoft AI says MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming handles 60 languages with words appearing in as little as 320 milliseconds, at $0.54 per audio hour.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-microsoft-mai-voice-2/

Trump tells TIME the US might take stakes in OpenAI, Anthropic

Asked why Washington holds a 10% Intel stake but nothing in frontier labs, Trump told TIME: "I might. Maybe I could do that."

https://theaipost.net/story/find-trump-time-ai-stakes/

Anthropic filing shows Broadcom will lend up to $42 billion

Anthropic's IPO prospectus says Broadcom agreed to lend up to $42 billion by convertible note to help pay for a $125.2 billion, five-year TPU lease, Reuters reports.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-broadcom-42b/

OpenAI fires three safety researchers over sensitive information

OpenAI says it parted ways with three researchers for mishandling sensitive information, which the Wall Street Journal reports they shared with an outside AI-safety organisation.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-fires-safety-researchers/

California attorney general serves subpoena on OpenAI over cyber incidents

Rob Bonta's office says it is asking OpenAI more questions about cybersecurity incidents and risks involving its models, and cites last month's Hugging Face incident.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-california-ag-openai-subpoena/

Sony brings AI upscaling to the standard PS5 with QSSR

Sony says QSSR, a lighter version of the PS5 Pro's PSSR built with AMD, arrives today as a graphics option in Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-sony-qssr-ps5/

ComfyUI opens its Comfy Agent to every Comfy Cloud user

Comfy says its in-app agent plans, builds and fixes workflows on the canvas, is free to try on Comfy Cloud, and reaches the desktop app in a few weeks.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-comfy-agent-cloud/

Meta's Muse hits 5 million downloads in 22 days, Sensor Tower says

Meta's AI app passed 5 million US and Canada downloads faster than ChatGPT, Grok or Claude did, per Sensor Tower, as OpenAI answers with Dots.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-muse-5m-downloads-dots/

Cloudflare releases Clef, its first open models, to rival Jev at classification

Cloudflare says its 27B Clef decision model tops the Jev Decision Index at a 209-millisecond median, and both Clef models ship free on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-cloudflare-clef/

Solo developer's open-source Jev clone runs on a laptop CPU and has 1,200 stars

Federico Elia's jevos answers yes-or-no questions in 26 to 112 milliseconds on a CPU with no GPU, and his launch post for it has about 2,400 likes on X.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-jevos-open-jev-clone/

AI coding agents posted 13,000 internal screenshots to public GitHub repos
https://theaipost.net/story/c32f17587/

Google sends four TPUs to orbit on a SpaceX rocket for Project Suncatcher
https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-tpus-suncatcher-orbit/

Volantis raises $88 million for lasers that link AI chips to 220 memory chips

Volantis says Face ID-style lasers could wire one GPU to 220 memory chips, against eight on Nvidia's top parts, though its first system is not due until 2027.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-volantis-88m-photonic-memory/

Nebius buys Inferize, which says it restores a warm GPU in 20 seconds, not 23 minutes

The 17-person Tel Aviv startup claims GPU snapshots cut a DeepSeek V4 Pro cold start roughly 70-fold, and reports value the deal at $100 million to $150 million.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nebius-inferize/

Dell, JERA and RHAELM plan a 400MW AI data centre beside a power plant

The $15 billion Chiba campus would draw power straight from JERA's own generators instead of the grid, with phased operation from 2028, according to JERA's announcement.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-jera-dell-rhaelm-chiba/

Hawley and Murphy plan a bill making AI firms liable when their agents hack
https://theaipost.net/story/hawley-murphy-ai-agent-accountability/

Anthropic makes Claude for Government generally available to US agencies

Anthropic says federal and state agencies can now buy Claude through a FedRAMP High environment with no seat fees, a hard spending cap and no cloud-provider contract.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-claude-for-government-ga/

GPT-6 Astra helps read a 217-year-old cipher letter to Napoleon's marshal
https://theaipost.net/story/find-marmont-cipher-gpt6-astra/

Research firm says AI agents probed a Canadian archive site, OpenAI reviewing
https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-agents-canada-library-archives/

South Korea's chip exports triple to $60.3 billion on AI demand

Semiconductors made up almost half of South Korea's record $120.9 billion in September exports, Reuters reported, as shipments rose 262.8% from a year earlier.

https://theaipost.net/story/korea-september-exports-record-chips/

Grokipedia v0.3 adds 3D book shelves and a redesigned homepage

SpaceXAI's Wikipedia rival, which Elon Musk says could one day become Encyclopedia Galactica, now shows featured articles as rotatable books and lists recent changes on its front page.

https://theaipost.net/story/grokipedia-v03/

260M-parameter image model tops one 6.5 times bigger, authors say
https://theaipost.net/story/cf964e66f/

Agent speed benchmark puts GPT-6 Astra first, open models nowhere
https://theaipost.net/story/c7afa8ac6/

Flow raises $50M at $750M to put AI agents on hardware design

The San Francisco startup says its agents check CAD drawings against requirements and test data. Anduril, Rivian and Joby Aviation are listed as customers, TechCrunch reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/flow-engineering-50m-series-b/

OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol is its most demanded model ever

OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux says GPT-6.1 Sol drew record demand after DevDay, priced at $2 and $10 per million tokens against a $3.26 task cost for GPT-6 Astra.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gpt-61-sol-devday/

Artificial Analysis puts Gemini 4 Argon level with GPT-6 Astra

The benchmark firm scores Google's unreleased Gemini 4 Argon 53 on its Intelligence Index, with a 15% hallucination rate against 51% for GPT-6 Astra.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-4-argon-aa-index/

AI chiefs sign a White House pledge that is only morally binding

Executives from Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Nvidia signed a Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities that carries no legal force.

https://theaipost.net/story/trump-frontier-responsibilities-accord/

Senate blocks House-passed data-centre power bill 57-43 on party lines
https://theaipost.net/story/senate-blocks-ratepayer-protection-act/
